description.en: Dark Matter Dragonfruits are shadow plants that damage zombies with dark energies. Make zombies heavier and slower when powered by other Shadow plants.
description.zh: 暗物质火龙果是一种暗影植物，用暗能量伤害僵尸。当其他暗影植物为其提供能量时，能使僵尸更沉重。

chat.en: Dark Matter Dragonfruit's ancestors were hunted to the depths of space. Now their descendants are back for cold, fruity vengeance.
chat.zh: 暗物质火龙果的祖先曾被猎杀至太空深处。如今，他们的后代带着冰冷的果实复仇归来了。

text.en: zombies caught in the dark energy explosion will take higher damage than those who directly contact his projectiles
text.zh: 比起直接接触其子弹的僵尸，受到子弹暗能量爆炸波及的僵尸会受到更高的伤害

text.en: when powered, the more healthy zombies are, the heavier they'll become
text.zh: 得到暗影能量时，僵尸越健全，沉重效果越显著

text.en: heavy zombies' movements become slower and will be harder to knockback
text.zh: 沉重的僵尸行动会更缓慢，并且难以击退
